correctness.rationale: The exact QP correction is reconstructed as the projection of \(u=(0,-1)\) onto the active linearized disk half-space. Exact algebra gives \(x^+=ch\), proves the corrected full iterate is strictly inside the disk, proves the next half-step is strictly outside, and yields a uniform contraction for \(d_t=\|h_t-u\|^2\). Induction and the contraction establish the quantified claim; the packaged exact-rational checker is supporting evidence only.
